protocol.generator: Unchanged formula from the preserved upstream make_weights; new seed strings
protocol.targets: Uniform middle 40% integer interval, conditional on attainable residues mod 8,10,16,32
protocol.differences: Common adjacent half-sum gaps, descending product of gap frequencies; integer gap tie break
protocol.representation_cap: Minimum basic cap and residue-wise sum-of-minima matching caps

sampling.band: Hoeffding, alpha/3 at each checkpoint, intersect original certified interval
sampling.decisions: Exact half-sum membership; all preprocessing charged

protocol.exact_set: Positive-weight DP truncated at upper target, from scratch
protocol.memory: Separate tracemalloc runs for first list of each stratum and every method; includes preprocessing; excludes interpreter baseline
protocol.timing: One untraced standalone run per method and list; reproducibly shuffled order within certificate and oracle groups; no preprocessing reused
protocol.truth: Full truncated set DP on every fresh list; compare bitset where feasible; truth evaluated after certificates
protocol.disjointness: No repeated sorted weights within study or across any original cohort
protocol.scope: Fixed deterministic algorithms plus exact-decision sampling; no learned extension or new calibration fit
protocol.acceptance: All deterministic intervals contain integer truth; regression aggregates match transcript; independently checked proof implementation
